habits that will make you
disgustingly confident

speaking first in class

make yourself say one thing in the first five minutes of any class or meeting. the longer you wait, the harder it gets, so speak early and the fear never builds.

walking without headphones

walk through busy places without headphones once a day. being fully present among strangers, with nothing to hide behind, is quiet confidence training.

a daily lesson

spend 5 minutes a day learning something new: a myth, a planet, a famous painting. knowing you can talk about something interesting makes walking into any room easier.
slides.texte_sophia:
a daily lesson

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something new: a myth, a planet, a painting. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and walking into any room got so much easier.

slides.texte_overlay:
sending the message

send the text you've been rewriting for an hour. most confident people aren't braver, they just stopped overthinking the small things and pressed send.

dressing for yourself

wear the thing you love on an ordinary day, not just a special one. dressing for yourself is a daily reminder that other people's opinions are optional.
